tagline: A rural-feeling retreat at the northern edge of the Belgrade Forest — horse farms, forest roads, and weekend getaway energy within Istanbul's city limits.

items.name: Belgrad Ormanı (Kuzey Girişi)
items.description: The northern reaches of the Belgrade Forest — less visited than the main entrances and wilder as a result. Long trails through ancient woodland.
items.tip: This end of the forest is significantly quieter than the Bahçeköy entrance. Bring a trail map — paths are less signed here.

items.name: At Çiftlikleri
items.description: Several working horse farms in the Kemerburgaz area open for trail riding through the forest. A surprising experience this close to the city.

items.name: Köy Kafeleri ve Çay Bahçeleri
items.description: Village tea gardens and simple cafés along the main road through Kemerburgaz — popular weekend stops for those driving to and from the forest.

items.name: Köy Restoranları
items.description: Rustic village restaurants serving grilled meats and meze. Best on a Sunday afternoon after a forest walk.

tips: Kemerburgaz is only realistically accessible by car — no meaningful public transport from the city centre.
Best as a day trip destination for hiking and horse riding rather than a base for living.
The forest roads are popular with mountain bikers and trail runners on weekends.
Combine with Göktürk for a full day out in Istanbul's green northern belt.
